sentences.en: People are often quite skeptical about things unless given believable proof.
sentences.zh: 人们通常对事情持怀疑态度，除非有令人信服的证据。

sentences.en: The pundit on TV says we're all doomed. Me, I'm skeptical.
sentences.zh: 电视上的评论员说我们都完了。我呢，我觉得这很值得怀疑。

sentences.en: People are very skeptical these days unless you show them definitive proof.
sentences.zh: 如今人们非常挑剔，除非你给他们看确凿的证据。

senses.zh: 不相信的，持怀疑态度的；（哲）怀疑论的，不可知论的
